lead: A week defined by long-end UST stress, fiscal-dominance confirmation from Alden, Strive/Bitcoin market-structure noise, and Gromen’s electricity/reshoring inflation warning.

themes.title: The bond market is the story
themes.body: 10Y yields printed multi-decade highs then eased; mortgage rates jumped to 7.28%. Alden: curve flat not steep — the argument is about the level of rates. Gromen: more UST supply as coupons reprice toward 5%+, deficits heading $2T→$3T. Mandell: “break it, buy it” between Treasury and Fed.

themes.title: Fiscal dominance as base case
themes.body: Alden’s “gradual print” framing: 7% stimulatory deficits pre-run recessions. Quality-over-quantity FinTwit posture — signal is what she objects to amid AI noise.

themes.title: Bitcoin capital markets / Strive cluster
themes.body: Walton: Buy Bitcoin; SATA at par with heavy volume. Cole: MSCI ESG hostility toward BTC cos is a $21T-benchmark problem. Mandell: BTC rally with no retracement; ASST/STRC microstructure notes.

themes.title: Energy, manufacturing, AI power
themes.body: Gromen ties dollar hegemony to manufacturing and flags Ferguson’s Law (interest > military). Pal flips the AI-power panic: China solar scale and Wright’s Law as the supply answer; Token2049 Singapore next week.

themes.title: Valuation caution (background)
themes.body: Felder’s recent posts (less frequent lately) still hammer bubble/fragility themes — useful counterweight when BTC and AI narratives run hot.

wire.title: Treasury yields pull back from multi-decade highs; bond reversal talk
wire.summary: 10Y eased after hitting highs not seen since 2002; TLT watched as oversold after a brutal quarter.

wire.title: 30-year mortgage hits 7.28%, highest since 2023
wire.summary: Biggest weekly jump in four years as long-end Treasury selloff feeds into housing costs.

wire.title: US stocks rebound modestly as yields ease from 2002 highs
wire.summary: S&P +0.2% on choppy Oct open; Micron AI memory and energy helped the bounce.

wire.title: Stablecoin issuers fill gap from China’s Treasury sales
wire.summary: SF Fed note: Tether/Circle Treasury holdings offset ~40% of China’s reductions.

sourcesNote: Weekly is a human-style distill of the daily voice set. Markets: Yahoo Finance. Not investment advice.
